outcome: Natural courses of incarcerated gravid uterus
Perinatal outcomes of incarcerated gravid uterus
cohort: Pregnant women with incarcerated gravid uterus at Osaka City University Hospital between April 2011 and March 2021
finding: Approximately 1 in 2300 pregnancies remained incarcerated at term or near-term, and 78.5% of cases resolved spontaneously after 16 weeks of gestation.
